title: Earring Finder and Stats
features:
(I did not test on mobile so idk if it has good mobile support)

Finds Earrings, Esps them for you. (doesn't work atm, patched)

Shows your stats.

Shows Level, Reputation, Rebirths, and Rank.

Shows the time of day (kinda useless, just useless for when you're not outside ig)

has a notifier incase you just want to chill or play without having the gui on your screen. (it does the stupid roblox notification shit)

Mobile Support for the skids.
Click on your username in the bottom left to toggle the gui. 
Click on the white x in the top right to destroy the gui.

There's also a reset button, since this game doesn't allow you to reset for some reason. (Don't use it when you're knocked, it won't work.)
